column1: # Prisma. Rule: every named block is a definition. model, view, enum and
# composite type are class; datasource and generator are variable (a named
# configuration). Fields (column_declaration) are NOT extracted: a field is not
# addressable outside its model and indexing every field drowns the models.
# Attributes (@id, @@map, @relation), enum values, configuration keys inside
# datasource/generator and calls such as env() and autoincrement() are not
